Name: ch2_intro
Dialogue: Setiap hari seperti ini... bekerja dari pagi, pulang malam, dan tak ada satu pun untuk diriku sendiri
EN: Every day is the same… work from morning, come home at night, and not a single moment just for myself.

Name: ch2_ryan1
Dialogue: Ya?
EN: Yeah?

Name: ch2_mikey1
Dialogue: Aku sering melihatmu lewat sini. Kamu tinggal di sekitar sini juga, ya?
EN: I see you passing by here a lot. You live nearby?

Name: ch2_ryan2
Dialogue: Iya, di Kost Mawar Hitam
EN: Yeah, at Black Rose House.

Name: ch2_mikey2
Dialogue: Oh ya? Lantai berapa?
EN: Oh really? Which floor?

Name: ch2_ryan3
Dialogue: Lantai dua, kamar 201
EN: Second floor, room 201.

Name: ch2_mikey3
Dialogue: Benarkah? Aku tinggal di 208. Kita satu lantai!
EN: No way… I’m in 208. We’re on the same floor!

Name: ch2_mikey_calling
Dialogue: Oy!
EN: Hey!

Name: ch2_tired_1
Dialogue: Beberapa orang pulang ke rumah, disambut aroma masakan dan suara yang menenangkan.
EN: Some people come home to the smell of cooking and the sound of something comforting.

Name: ch2_tired_2
Dialogue: Aku disambut layar laptop dan deadline tugas yang terus menghantui
EN: I come home to my laptop screen and deadlines that never stop haunting me.

Name: ch2_tired_3
Dialogue: Mereka bisa sakit dan tetap tenang, ada yang rawat, ada yang peduli.
EN: They can get sick and still feel at ease, because someone takes care of them, someone cares.

Name: ch2_tired_4
Dialogue: Aku? Tak ada waktu bahkan untuk mengeluh... tugas harus selesai, hidup harus jalan
EN: Me? I don’t even have time to complain… work has to get done, life has to go on.

Name: ch2_tired_5
Dialogue: Dan semuanya hanya demi bertahan…
EN: And all of it just to survive…

Name: ch2_tired_6
Dialogue: Bayar sewa, isi perut, sambil pura-pura kuat di tengah hidup yang rasanya makin sempit
EN: Pay rent, fill my stomach, pretending to be strong while life feels smaller and smaller.

Name: ch2_intro2
Dialogue: Aku lelah... bukan hanya tubuhku, tapi semuanya
EN: I’m tired… not just my body, but everything.

Name: ch2_ryan4
Dialogue: Ngomong-ngomong kakimu kenapa?
EN: By the way, what happened to your leg?

Name: ch2_mikey4
Dialogue: Terkilir. Tadi pagi aku bermain basket... terlalu semangat mungkin
EN: Twisted it. Played basketball this morning… maybe got a little too excited.

Name: ch2_mikey5
Dialogue: Untungnya tidak terlalu parah
EN: Luckily, it’s not too bad.

Name: ch2_mikey6
Dialogue: Orang tuaku juga langsung datang, jadi bisa dirawat di sini
EN: My parents came right away, so I can get proper care here.

Name: ch2_ryan5
Dialogue: Oh ya... syukurlah kalau begitu
EN: Oh, glad to hear that.

Name: ch2_mikey7
Dialogue: Oiya, ngomong-ngomong... ibuku kebetulan masak ayam kecap sore ini. Katanya biar aku cepat pulih
EN: Oh, and by the way… my mom’s making soy sauce chicken tonight. She says it’ll help me recover faster.

Name: ch2_ryan6
Dialogue: (Ayam kecap... Itu makanan favoritku)
EN: (Soy sauce chicken… my favorite.)

Name: ch2_mikey8
Dialogue: Mampirlah sebentar. Kita makan malam bersama
EN: You should drop by. We can have dinner together.

Name: ch2_ryan7
Dialogue: Terima kasih, tapi... aku masih ada yang harus dikerjakan
EN: Thanks, but… I still have work to finish.

Name: ch2_mikey9
Dialogue: Oh, oke... ya sudah
EN: Oh, okay… fair enough.

Name: ch2_ryan8
Dialogue: Kalau begitu, aku pamit dulu
EN: Well then, I’ll get going.

Name: ch2_mikey10
Dialogue: Baiklah. Sampai jumpa lagi, Ryan!
EN: Alright. See you around, Ryan!

Name: ch2_intermezo
Dialogue: Kenalkan namaku Michael
EN: I’m Michael, by the way.

Name: ch2_intermezo2
Dialogue: Namaku Ryan
EN: I’m Ryan.

Name: ch2_intermezo3
Dialogue: Hi Ryan! Senang berkenalan denganmu!
EN: Hi Ryan! Nice to meet you!

Name: ch2_daydream
Dialogue: Andai aku masih punya tempat untuk pulang seperti itu…
EN: If only I still had a place like that to come home to…

Name: ch2_postmikey
Dialogue: Andai aku masih punya tempat untuk pulang seperti itu…
EN: If only I still had somewhere warm to return to…

Name: ch2_beforeenter
Dialogue: Aku punya hal yang lebih penting daripada makan malam hangat dan obrolan ringan
EN: I have more important things than warm dinners and small talk.

Name: ch2_beforeenter2
Dialogue: Tugas kuliahku tidak akan selesai dengan sendirinya
EN: My assignments won’t finish themselves.

Name: ch2_sepi
Dialogue: Lumayan sepi sore ini, pas buat makan sebentar
EN: Pretty quiet this afternoon, perfect for a quick bite.

Name: ch2_sepi_2
Dialogue: Akan kuhangatkan makanan yang baru saja kubeli barusan
EN: I’ll heat up the food I just bought earlier.

Name: ch2_sepi_3
Dialogue: Kalau makan sekarang, nanti di rumah tinggal kerjakan tugas
EN: If I eat now, I can go straight to my assignments when I get home.

Name: ch2_sepi_4
Dialogue: Kadang rasanya enak juga kalau toko lagi tenang begini
EN: Sometimes it feels nice when the shop’s this quiet.

Name: ch2_windah
Dialogue: Apakah ini saja?
EN: Is that all?

Name: ch2_windah2
Dialogue: Yap
EN: Yep.

Name: ch2_windah3
Dialogue: Baiklah totalnya dua dolar lima puluh sen
EN: Alright, that’ll be two dollars fifty.

Name: ch2_windah4
Dialogue: Kamu terlihat kurang bersemangat hari ini
EN: You seem a little down today.

Name: ch2_windah5
Dialogue: Terima kasih atas perhatiannya. Ada lagi yang bisa saya bantu?
EN: Thanks for noticing. Anything else I can help you with?

Name: ch2_windah6
Dialogue: Oke kata-kata hari ini....
EN: Okay, today’s quote…

Name: ch2_windah7
Dialogue: Pergi ke pasar beli belimbing
EN: Roses are reds, violets are blue

Name: ch2_windah8
Dialogue: Cakep...?
EN: Nice…?

Name: ch2_windah9
Dialogue: Kalian para viewers, kalian terlahir cantik dan tampan
EN: You viewers out there, you were all born beautiful and handsome.

Name: ch2_windah10
Dialogue: Dan kalian layak mendapatkan pasangan yang menyayangi kalian
EN: And you deserve someone who truly loves and cares for you.

Name: ch2_windah11
Dialogue: Loh kok begitu?
EN: Huh? Why’s that?

Name: ch2_windah12
Dialogue: Emang gitu pantunnya kocak
EN: That’s just how the saying goes, silly.

Name: ch2_hungry
Dialogue: Aku lapar
EN: I’m hungry.

Name: ch2_andy
Dialogue: Kau percaya dengan dunia semu?
EN: Do you believe in an Semu realm?

Name: ch2_andy2
Dialogue: Dunia di mana kau bisa mendapatkan apa pun… kekayaan, kekuatan…
EN: A world where you can get anything… wealth, power…

Name: ch2_andy3
Dialogue: Ada lagi yang mau kau beli?
EN: Anything else you want to buy?

Name: ch2_andy4
Dialogue: ...Bahkan orang yang paling kau rindukan
EN: …Even the person you miss the most.

Name: ch2_andy5
Dialogue: Maaf saya tidak tertarik
EN: Sorry, I’m not interested.

Name: ch2_andy6
Dialogue: Totalnya jadi $2
EN: That’ll be $2.

Name: ch2_andy7
Dialogue: Kau akan mengerti. Cepat atau lambat
EN: You’ll understand, sooner or later.

Name: ch2_andy8
Dialogue: Terima kasih, silahkan datang kembali
EN: Thank you, please come again.

Name: ch2_akhir2ini
Dialogue: Akhir-akhir ini… terlalu banyak orang bicara hal yang tidak masuk akal
EN: Lately… too many people have been talking nonsense.
